# 디아2-인게임-내비게이터 (D2R-HUD v1.4)

외부 오버레이 프로그램 없이 **디아블로 II: 레저렉션(`D2R.exe`) 게임 클라이언트 자체 UI 엔진(`data/global/ui/layouts/*hd.json`)에서 직접 구동되는 순정 인게임 내비게이터 & 호라드림 대사전 모드**입니다.

---

## 1. 실제 인게임 구동 화면 (`1막 자매단 야영지`)

| 원본 퀘스트 기록(`Q`) — 1~5막 동선·길찾기 연동 | `Tab` 미니맵 + 좌측 상단/중단 투명 HUD 수직 정렬 |
| :---: | :---: |
| ![퀘스트 기록 1막](docs/screenshots/d2r_real_ingame_2_questlog_act1.png) | ![Tab 미니맵 및 좌측 HUD](docs/screenshots/d2r_real_ingame_5_automap_tab.png) |
| ![퀘스트 기록 2막](docs/screenshots/d2r_real_ingame_3_questlog_act2.png) | ![퀘스트 기록 3막](docs/screenshots/d2r_real_ingame_4_questlog_act3.png) |

---

## 2. 핵심 기능 (v1.4 최신 반영)

1. **원본 퀘스트 기록(`Q`) 완벽 통합 (`questlogpanelexpansionhd.json` / `D2RHudQLAct1~5hd.json`)**
   - 퀘스트 창(`Q`) 상단 확장 탭(`1막HUD` ~ `5막HUD`, `길찾기맵`, `스타터`) 및 로마자 탭(`I` ~ `V`) 클릭 시 **해당 막의 필수 보상 퀘스트·핵심 동선·던전 길찾기 방향 공식**을 하단 스크롤 창에 즉시 출력합니다.
   - 우측 상단 버튼으로 **투명 HUD 전환**, **투명 HUD 켜기/끄기**, **룬·큐빙 사전 열기**를 바로 제어합니다.

2. **좌측 정렬 `Tab` 지도 HUD & 크기 조절형 퀘스트 HUD (`automaphd.json` / `D2RHudTrackerPanelhd.json`)**
   - **`Tab` 미니맵 연동 HUD (`x: 24, y: 18`)**: `Tab` 키로 미니맵을 켜면 우측 미니맵을 가리지 않고 **화면 좌측 상단**에 12대 핵심 던전 길찾기 방향 공식이 함께 표시됩니다.
   - **크기 조절형 투명 퀘스트 HUD (`x: 24, y: 468`)**: 좌측 중단에 수직 정렬되며 `▲ 접기` / `소형 4줄` / `중형 7줄` / `대형 12줄` / `완전투명·가독배경`을 실시간으로 전환할 수 있습니다.

3. **투명 호라드림 룬워드·큐빙 대사전 (`D2RHudMainPanelhd.json`)**
   - `캠페인 1~3막`, `캠페인 4~5막·길찾기`, `초반육성·스타터`, `룬워드 2~3홈`, `룬워드 4홈`, `룬워드 5~6홈·신규(악마술사 포함 98종)`, `호라드림 큐빙 60종`을 소형/중형/대형 크기로 조회하며 마우스오버 툴팁으로 완성 옵션을 확인합니다.

4. **디아블로 II: 레저렉션 원본 색상 토큰 100% 통일**
   - 탭(`$TabsActiveTextColorInGame`/`$TabsInactiveTextColor`), 버튼(`$LightButtonTextColor`/`$FontColorGoldYellow`), 본문(`$FontColorGoldYellow`/`$FontColorLightGold`/`$DescriptionTextColor`/`$PanelNoteTextColor`), 툴팁(`ÿc4`/`ÿc0`) 모두 레저렉션 순정 UI 컬러 팔레트와 1:1로 통일했습니다.

---

## 3. 빌드 및 MPQ 설치 방법

```bash
npm run mod:build
npm run mod:install
```

- `D:\Diablo II Resurrected\mods\yupgoolg\yupgoolg.mpq` 내부에 72개 네이티브 UI 레이아웃 JSON 파일이 자동 패킹·검증됩니다.
- 게임 실행 인자: `-mod yupgoolg -txt`

---

## 4. GitHub 원클릭 저장/가져오기 & AI 에이전트 빠른 접근

### A. 내 GitHub 저장소 원클릭 동기화 (`github-sync.bat` 또는 `npm run`)
- **원클릭 저장 (AI 번들 자동 갱신 + Commit + Push + 원격 검증)**:
  ```bash
  github-sync.bat save "수정 내역 메시지"
  # 또는: npm run github:save
  ```
- **최신 소스 가져오기 (Pull)**:
  ```bash
  github-sync.bat pull
  # 또는: npm run github:pull
  ```
- **저장소 동기화 상태 확인 및 내 전체 GitHub 저장소 목록 조회**:
  ```bash
  github-sync.bat status
  github-sync.bat repos
  ```

### B. 외부 AI (ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini / Cursor 등) 단일 URL 소스 접근
다른 AI나 에이전트에게 아래 URL 하나만 전달하면 저장소를 클론하지 않고도 프로젝트 구조와 전체 핵심 소스를 즉시 읽어 작업할 수 있습니다.
- **요약 및 Raw URL 맵 (`llms.txt`)**: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icandoit122118-del/D2R-HUD/main/llms.txt`
- **전체 핵심 소스 통합 번들 (`llms-full.txt`)**: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icandoit122118-del/D2R-HUD/main/llms-full.txt`
- **머신 리더블 JSON 매니페스트 (`ai-repo-index.json`)**: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icandoit122118-del/D2R-HUD/main/ai-repo-index.json`

function stripJsonComments(str) {
  let out = '';
  let inString = false;
  let escape = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
    const ch = str[i];
    const next = str[i + 1];
    if (inString) {
      out += ch;
      if (escape) {
        escape = false;
      } else if (ch === '\\') {
        escape = true;
      } else if (ch === '"') {
        inString = false;
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (ch === '"') {
      inString = true;
      out += ch;
      continue;
    }
    if (ch === '/' && next === '/') {
      while (i < str.length && str[i] !== '\n') i++;
      out += '\n';
      continue;
    }
    if (ch === '/' && next === '*') {
      i += 2;
      while (i < str.length && !(str[i] === '*' && str[i + 1] === '/')) i++;
      i++;
      continue;
    }
    out += ch;
  }
  return out.replace(/,\s*([}\]])/g, '$1');
}

function readD2RJson(filePath) {
  const raw = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8').replace(/^\uFEFF/, '');
  return JSON.parse(stripJsonComments(raw));
}

function ensureDir(dir) {
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
}

function writeJson(filePath, obj) {
  ensureDir(path.dirname(filePath));
  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(obj, null, 2) + '\n', 'utf8');
}

function sanitizeD2RText(str) {
  if (!str) return '';
  return String(str)
    .replace(/[•✓✔]/g, '·')
    .replace(/[▸▹►]/g, '▶')
    .replace(/[└┗]/g, '→')
    .replace(/[—–]/g, '-');
}

function splitIntoSingleLines(str, maxLen = 44, contPrefix = '   ') {
  const clean = sanitizeD2RText(str);
  if (clean.length <= maxLen) return [clean];
  const words = clean.split(' ');
  const lines = [];
  let cur = '';
  for (const w of words) {
    const candidate = cur ? `${cur} ${w}` : w;
    if (candidate.length > maxLen && cur.length > 0) {
      lines.push(cur);
      cur = `${contPrefix}${w}`;
    } else {
      cur = candidate;
    }
  }
  if (cur) lines.push(cur);
  return lines;
}

// High-contrast crisp drop shadow for transparent HUD text over live game world
const HUD_TRANSPARENT_SHADOW = {
  shadowColor: { r: 0, g: 0, b: 0, a: 255 },
  offset: { x: 3, y: 3 }
};

function makeTextStyle(colorVar, sizeVar, alignH = 'left', alignV = 'center', lineWrap = false) {
  return {
    fontColor: colorVar,
    pointSize: sizeVar,
    alignment: { h: alignH, v: alignV },
    options: { lineWrap, newlineHandling: 'standard', pipeCharacterBehavior: 'handle' },
    spacing: { leading: 1.24, kerning: 1.0 },
    dropShadow: HUD_TRANSPARENT_SHADOW
  };
}

/**
 * Builds a 100% aligned, dynamic-height ScrollBar widget that NEVER overflows
 * regardless of whether the window height is 156px (4 lines), 296px (8 lines),
 * 450px (QuestLog), or 540px (15 lines).
 * - Uses a Widget container at { x, y, width: 24, height: heightPx }
 * - Draws a centered 4px gold track bar between the up and down arrow buttons
 * - Places ScrollControllerWidget at { x: 0, y: 0, width: 24, height: heightPx }
 *   with NO anchor offset so the up arrow, thumb indicator, and down arrow sit
 *   coaxially at x: 0..24.
 */
function makeAlignedScrollBar(xPos, yPos, heightPx, controllerName = 'ScrollController', viewName = 'ScrollView') {
  const trackHeight = Math.max(40, heightPx - 44);
  return {
    type: 'Widget',
    name: `ScrollBarWrap_${controllerName}`,
    fields: {
      rect: { x: xPos, y: yPos, width: 24, height: heightPx }
    },
    children: [
      {
        type: 'RectangleWidget',
        name: `ScrollTrackBg_${controllerName}`,
        fields: {
          rect: { x: 8, y: 22, width: 8, height: trackHeight },
          color: [0.08, 0.07, 0.05, 0.72]
        }
      },
      {
        type: 'RectangleWidget',
        name: `ScrollTrackLine_${controllerName}`,
        fields: {
          rect: { x: 10, y: 22, width: 4, height: trackHeight },
          color: [0.55, 0.44, 0.22, 0.85]
        }
      },
      {
        type: 'ScrollControllerWidget',
        name: controllerName,
        fields: {
          rect: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 24, height: heightPx },
          upArrowFilepath: 'FrontEnd\\HD\\Final\\FrontEnd_ScrollUpBtn',
          downArrowFilepath: 'FrontEnd\\HD\\Final\\FrontEnd_ScrollDownBtn',
          barFilepath: 'FrontEnd\\HD\\Final\\FrontEnd_ScrollIndicator',
          viewName,
          buttonScrollAmount: 76,
          wheelScrollSound: 'cursor_scroll_hd',
          buttonScrollSound: 'cursor_scroll_hd'
        }
      }
    ]
  };
}

function makeDividerRow(width = 1480) {
  return {
    type: 'TableRowWidget',
    name: 'RowDivider',
    children: [
      {
        type: 'ImageWidget',
        name: 'Divider',
        fields: {
          rect: { x: 4, y: 24, width, height: 4 },
          filename: 'PauseMenu\\Divider'
        }
      }
    ]
  };
}

function makeSingleTextRow(col1Text, col1Color, col1Size, col2Text = '', col2Color = '$FontColorLightGold', col2Size = '$SmallFontSize', tooltip = '') {
  const children = [
    {
      type: 'LayoutItemWidget',
      name: 'Col1Wrap',
      fields: { marginTop: 3, marginBottom: 3 },
      children: [
        {
          type: 'TextBoxWidget',
          name: 'Col1Text',
          fields: {
            fitToText: true,
            text: sanitizeD2RText(col1Text),
            style: makeTextStyle(col1Color, col1Size, 'left', 'center', false)
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  ];

  if (col2Text || tooltip) {
    const col2Child = tooltip
      ? {
          type: 'ButtonWidget',
          name: 'Col2TooltipBtn',
          fields: {
            rect: { scale: 0.54 },
            filename: 'FrontEnd\\HD\\Final\\FrontEnd_ButtonMed',
            hoveredFrame: 3,
            textString: sanitizeD2RText(col2Text || '상세 옵션'),
            textColor: col2Color,
            'text/style': '$StyleFEButtonText',
            tooltipString: sanitizeD2RText(tooltip),
            pressedFrame: 0,
            sound: 'cursor_select'
          }
        }
      : {
          type: 'TextBoxWidget',
          name: 'Col2Text',
          fields: {
            fitToText: true,
            text: sanitizeD2RText(col2Text),
            style: makeTextStyle(col2Color, col2Size, 'center', 'center', false)
          }
        };

    children.push({
      type: 'LayoutItemWidget',
      name: 'Col2Wrap',
      fields: { marginTop: 3, marginBottom: 3 },
      children: [col2Child]
    });
  }

  return {
    type: 'TableRowWidget',
    name: 'DataRow',
    children
  };
}

function pushWrappedRows(rows, col1Text, col1Color, col1Size, col2Text = '', col2Color = '$FontColorLightGold', col2Size = '$SmallFontSize', tooltip = '') {
  const maxLen = col1Size === '$MediumLargeFontSize' ? 38 : col1Size === '$MediumFontSize' ? 42 : 48;
  const lines = splitIntoSingleLines(col1Text, maxLen, '   ');
  lines.forEach((line, idx) => {
    if (idx === 0) {
      rows.push(makeSingleTextRow(line, col1Color, col1Size, col2Text, col2Color, col2Size, tooltip));
    } else {
      rows.push(makeSingleTextRow(line, col1Color, col1Size, '', col2Color, col2Size, ''));
    }
  });
}

function generateCampaignRows(stepsSubset, includeMapRules = false) {
  const rows = [];
  for (const step of stepsSubset) {
    const tooltip = [
      `ÿc4[${step.condition.value}] ${step.location}ÿc0`,
      '',
      `ÿc4[최적 동선]ÿc0`,
      step.route,
      '',
      `ÿc4[길찾기 노트]ÿc0`,
      step.note,
      '',
      `ÿc4[보스 & 전략 팁]ÿc0`,
      step.strategic_tip
    ].join('\n');

    pushWrappedRows(
      rows,
      `■ [${step.condition.value}] ${step.location}`,
      '$FontColorGoldYellow',
      '$MediumFontSize',
      '공략 툴팁 보기',
      '$LightButtonTextColor',
      '$SmallFontSize',
      tooltip
    );
    pushWrappedRows(
      rows,
      `▶ 핵심 동선: ${step.route}`,
      '$FontColorLightGold',
      '$SmallFontSize',
      step.condition.value,
      '$FontColorGoldYellow',
      '$SmallFontSize'
    );
    for (let i = 0; i < step.tasks.length; i++) {
      const t = step.tasks[i];
      const isReward = t.text.includes('[필수') || t.text.includes('[보상');
      pushWrappedRows(
        rows,
        `  [${i + 1}] ${t.text}`,
        isReward ? '$FontColorLightGold' : '$DescriptionTextColor',
        '$SmallFontSize',
        isReward ? '★ 필수 보상' : '진행 체크',
        isReward ? '$FontColorGoldYellow' : '$PanelNoteTextColor',
        '$SmallFontSize'
      );
    }
    pushWrappedRows(
      rows,
      `  ★ 길찾기: ${step.note}`,
      '$PanelNoteTextColor',
      '$SmallFontSize',
      '핵심 팁',
      '$PanelNoteTextColor',
      '$SmallFontSize'
    );
    rows.push(makeDividerRow());
  }

  if (includeMapRules) {
    pushWrappedRows(
      rows,
      '★ 성역 던전 길찾기 방향 공식 12선 (입구 타일/웨이포인트 기준)',
      '$FontColorGoldYellow',
      '$MediumFontSize',
      '12개 핵심 던전',
      '$FontColorLightGold',
      '$SmallFontSize'
    );
    rows.push(makeDividerRow());
    for (const m of MAP_CHEATSHEET) {
      const tip = `ÿc4[${m.act}] ${m.zone}ÿc0\n\nÿc4[길찾기 공식]ÿc0\n${m.rule}\n\nÿc0${m.detail}`;
      pushWrappedRows(
        rows,
        `· [${m.act}] ${m.zone} → ${m.rule}`,
        '$DescriptionTextColor',
        '$SmallFontSize',
        '상세 설명 툴팁',
        '$LightButtonTextColor',
        '$SmallFontSize',
        tip
      );
    }
    rows.push(makeDividerRow());
  }

  return rows;
}

function generateStarterRows() {
  const rows = [];
  for (const step of warlockGuide.steps) {
    const tip = [
      `ÿc4[${step.condition.value}] ${step.location}ÿc0`,
      '',
      `ÿc4[파밍 루트]ÿc0 ${step.route}`,
      '',
      `ÿc4[핵심 주의사항]ÿc0 ${step.note}`,
      '',
      `ÿc4[시너지 & 팁]ÿc0 ${step.strategic_tip}`
    ].join('\n');

    pushWrappedRows(
      rows,
      `■ [${step.condition.value}] ${step.location}`,
      '$FontColorGoldYellow',
      '$MediumFontSize',
      '세팅 툴팁 보기',
      '$LightButtonTextColor',
      '$SmallFontSize',
      tip
    );
    pushWrappedRows(
      rows,
      `▶ 파밍 루트: ${step.route}`,
      '$FontColorLightGold',
      '$SmallFontSize',
      step.condition.value,
      '$FontColorGoldYellow',
      '$SmallFontSize'
    );
    for (let i = 0; i < step.tasks.length; i++) {
      pushWrappedRows(
        rows,
        `  [${i + 1}] ${step.tasks[i].text}`,
        '$DescriptionTextColor',
        '$SmallFontSize',
        '필수 세팅',
        '$FontColorLightGold',
        '$SmallFontSize'
      );
    }
    pushWrappedRows(
      rows,
      `  ★ 팁: ${step.strategic_tip}`,
      '$PanelNoteTextColor',
      '$SmallFontSize',
      '꿀팁',
      '$PanelNoteTextColor',
      '$SmallFontSize'
    );
    rows.push(makeDividerRow());
  }

  const extraGuides = [
    {
      title: '[레벨링 효율 구간] 1~15 트리스트럼 / 15~24 탈 라샤 무덤 / 24 고대인 / 25~40 보통 바알',
      sub: '40~60 악몽 바알 / 60~75 지옥 바알 / 75+ 공포의 영역(TZ) & 파괴의 부적 파밍',
      badge: '경험치 효율'
    },
    {
      title: '[용병 삼신기] 2막 기도 용병 + 통찰(랄+티르+탈+솔) + 치료(샤엘+이오+탈) + 배신(샤엘+주울+렘)',
      sub: '기도 오라 + 통찰 명상 오라 + 치료 정화 오라 3중 중첩으로 생명력·마나 초당 고속 회복',
      badge: '용병 완성'
    },
    {
      title: '[패캐/패힛 프레임 핵심] 원소술사 패캐: 63%(9프레임) → 105%(8프레임) / 번개: 117%',
      sub: '성기사(해머/피스트) 패캐: 75%(10프레임) → 125%(9프레임) / 영혼(Spirit) 35% 패캐가 핵심',
      badge: '프레임 표'
    }
  ];

  for (const g of extraGuides) {
    pushWrappedRows(rows, g.title, '$FontColorGoldYellow', '$SmallFontSize', g.badge, '$FontColorLightGold', '$SmallFontSize');
    pushWrappedRows(rows, `  · ${g.sub}`, '$DescriptionTextColor', '$SmallFontSize', '', '$DescriptionTextColor', '$SmallFontSize');
    rows.push(makeDividerRow());
  }

  return rows;
}

function generateRunewordRows(rwList, headerTitle) {
  const rows = [];
  pushWrappedRows(
    rows,
    `■ ${headerTitle} (총 ${rwList.length}종 - 우측 버튼 마우스 오버 시 전체 세부 옵션 표시)`,
    '$FontColorGoldYellow',
    '$MediumFontSize',
    `총 ${rwList.length}종 수록`,
    '$FontColorLightGold'
  );
  rows.push(makeDividerRow());

  for (const rw of rwList) {
    const runeCombo = (rw.runes || []).join(' + ');
    const itemTypes = (rw.item_types || []).join(', ');
    const statsLines = (rw.stats || []).map((s) => `· ${s}`).join('\n');
    const tooltip = [
      `ÿc4${rw.name} (${rw.original_name})ÿc0`,
      `ÿc4룬 조합: ${runeCombo}ÿc0`,
      `ÿc4재료: ${itemTypes} (요구 레벨 ${rw.level})ÿc0`,
      '',
      `ÿc4[완성 옵션]ÿc0`,
      statsLines,
      rw.material_sources ? `\nÿc0${rw.material_sources}` : ''
    ].join('\n');

    const topStats = (rw.stats || []).slice(0, 2).join(' / ');
    pushWrappedRows(
      rows,
      `■ ${rw.name} [${rw.original_name}] - 룬: ${runeCombo} (${itemTypes}, Lv.${rw.level})`,
      '$FontColorGoldYellow',
      '$MediumFontSize',
      '전체 옵션 툴팁',
      '$LightButtonTextColor',
      '$SmallFontSize',
      tooltip
    );
    pushWrappedRows(
      rows,
      `  ▶ 핵심 옵션: ${topStats}`,
      '$DescriptionTextColor',
      '$SmallFontSize',
      `${rw.category || ''}`,
      '$PanelNoteTextColor',
      '$SmallFontSize'
    );
    rows.push(makeDividerRow());
  }
  return rows;
}

function generateCubeRows() {
  const rows = [];
  pushWrappedRows(
    rows,
    `■ 호라드림의 함(큐브) 필수 조합법 ${cubing.length}종 (홈 뚫기·업그레이드·룬 합성·크래프트·면죄)`,
    '$FontColorGoldYellow',
    '$MediumFontSize',
    `총 ${cubing.length}종 레시피`,
    '$FontColorLightGold'
  );
  rows.push(makeDividerRow());

  for (const c of cubing) {
    const tooltip = [
      `ÿc4[${c.category}] ${c.name}ÿc0`,
      '',
      `ÿc4[조합 재료]ÿc0`,
      c.recipe,
      '',
      `ÿc4[변환 결과]ÿc0`,
      c.result,
      '',
      `ÿc0${c.description || ''}`
    ].join('\n');

    pushWrappedRows(
      rows,
      `■ [${c.category}] ${c.name} - 재료: ${c.recipe}`,
      '$FontColorGoldYellow',
      '$SmallFontSize',
      '상세 설명 툴팁',
      '$LightButtonTextColor',
      '$SmallFontSize',
      tooltip
    );
    pushWrappedRows(
      rows,
      `  ▶ 결과: ${c.result} (${c.description || ''})`,
      '$DescriptionTextColor',
      '$SmallFontSize',
      c.category,
      '$PanelNoteTextColor',
      '$SmallFontSize'
    );
    rows.push(makeDividerRow());
  }

  return rows;
}

// ============================================================================
// 2. 100% TRANSPARENT & ADJUSTABLE IN-GAME QUEST HUD (D2RHudTrackerPanel)
//    - App title (HudTitle) DELETED ("앱명도 삭제하고")
//    - Top tabs (OptionsTabs) HIDDEN OFF-SCREEN ("상단탭 다 삭제하고")
//    - Scrollbar UI 1:1 aligned via makeAlignedScrollBar() ("스크롤 UI 재조정해 안맞아아")
//    - Controlled directly from Original Quest Log (Q) Act 1~5 tabs + Extra tabs!
// ============================================================================
function buildTrackerMainPanel() {
  return {
    type: 'SettingsPanel',
    name: 'D2RHudTrackerPanel',
    fields: {
      priority: 205,
      rect: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 960, height: 36 },
      anchor: { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 }
    },
    children: [
      // OptionsTabs is kept off-screen at (-9999, -9999) so SettingsPanel C++ engine
      // still initializes D2RHudTrackAct1 and processes SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges
      // while rendering ZERO top tabs on screen!
      {
        type: 'TabBarWidget',
        name: 'OptionsTabs',
        fields: {
          rect: { x: -9999, y: -9999, scale: 0.001, width: 1, height: 1 },
          anchor: { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 },
          tabCount: 7,
          tabSize: { x: 1, y: 1 },
          tabPadding: { x: 0, y: 0 },
          filename: 'Controller/Panel/Stash/V2/StashTabs',
          inactiveFrames: [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
          activeFrames: [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
          textStrings: ['1', '2', '3', '4', '5', 'M', 'S'],
          tabMessages: [
            'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudTrackAct1',
            'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudTrackAct2',
            'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudTrackAct3',
            'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudTrackAct4',
            'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudTrackAct5',
            'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudTrackMap',
            'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudTrackStarter'
          ]

}

function expandTrackerLinesToTableRows(lines, prefix = 'Track') {
  const expandedRows = [];
  for (const item of lines) {
    const isHeader = item.size === '$MediumFontSize' || item.size === '$MediumLargeFontSize' || item.size === '$XMediumLargeFontSize';
    const maxLen = isHeader ? 31 : 35;
    const resolvedSize = isHeader ? '$MediumLargeFontSize' : '$XMediumFontSize';
    const chunks = splitIntoSingleLines(item.text, maxLen, '   ');
    for (const ch of chunks) {
      expandedRows.push({
        text: ch,
        color: item.color || '$FontColorWhite',
        size: resolvedSize
      });
    }
  }

  return expandedRows.map((item, idx) => ({
    type: 'TableRowWidget',
    name: `${prefix}Row_${idx}`,
    children: [
      {
        type: 'TextBoxWidget',
        name: `${prefix}Text_${idx}`,
        fields: {
          fitToText: true,
          text: item.text,
          style: makeTextStyle(item.color, item.size, 'left', 'center', false)
        }
      }
    ]
  }));
}

/**
 * Generates an adjustable transparent text output window sub-panel:
 *   suffix === 'S' : Small 4-line window (height 184px, dark readability backing)
 *   suffix === ''  : Medium 7-line window (height 322px, dark readability backing)
 *   suffix === 'L' : Large 12-line window (height 552px, dark readability backing)
 *   suffix === 'B' : 100% pure transparent 7-line window (height 322px, 0% tint)
 */
function buildTrackerSubPanel(tabKey, suffix, lines, escMessage = null) {
  const panelName = `D2RHudTrack${tabKey}${suffix}`;
  const heightPx = suffix === 'S' ? 230 : suffix === 'L' ? 598 : 368;
  const showReadabilityBg = suffix !== 'B';

  const tableRows = expandTrackerLinesToTableRows(lines, 'Track');
  const children = [];

  if (showReadabilityBg) {
    children.push(
      {
        type: 'RectangleWidget',
        name: 'SubtleTintBG',
        fields: {
          rect: { x: 0, y: 38, width: 952, height: heightPx + 10 },
          color: [0.02, 0.02, 0.04, 0.80]
        }
      },
      {
        type: 'RectangleWidget',
        name: 'SubtleTopAccent',
        fields: {
          rect: { x: 0, y: 38, width: 952, height: 3 },
          color: [0.78, 0.66, 0.38, 0.88]
        }
      }
    );
  }

  // Clean Window Size Adjustment Bar (NO app name, NO top tabs!)
  children.push(
    {
      type: 'ButtonWidget',
      name: 'SizeFoldBtn',
      fields: {
        rect: { x: 0, y: 0, scale: 0.38 },
        filename: 'FrontEnd\\HD\\Final\\FrontEnd_ButtonMed',
        hoveredFrame: 3,
        textString: '▲ 접기',
        onClickMessage: 'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudTrackFold',
        tooltipString: '글자 출력창 접기',
        textColor: '$LightButtonTextColor',
        'text/style': '$StyleFEButtonText',
        sound: 'select'
      }
    },
    {
      type: 'ButtonWidget',
      name: 'SizeSmallBtn',
      fields: {
        rect: { x: 138, y: 0, scale: 0.38 },
        filename: 'FrontEnd\\HD\\Final\\FrontEnd_ButtonMed',
        hoveredFrame: 3,
        textString: '소형 4줄',
        onClickMessage: `SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudTrack${tabKey}S`,
        tooltipString: '글자 출력창을 소형(4줄)으로 줄입니다.',
        textColor: suffix === 'S' ? '$FontColorGoldYellow' : '$LightButtonTextColor',
        'text/style': '$StyleFEButtonText',
        sound: 'select'
      }
    },
    {
      type: 'ButtonWidget',
      name: 'SizeMedBtn',
      fields: {
        rect: { x: 276, y: 0, scale: 0.38 },
        filename: 'FrontEnd\\HD\\Final\\FrontEnd_ButtonMed',
        hoveredFrame: 3,
        textString: '중형 7줄',
        onClickMessage: `SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudTrack${tabKey}`,
        tooltipString: '글자 출력창을 기본 중형(7줄)으로 조절합니다.',
        textColor: suffix === '' ? '$FontColorGoldYellow' : '$LightButtonTextColor',
        'text/style': '$StyleFEButtonText',
        sound: 'select'
      }
    },
    {
      type: 'ButtonWidget',
      name: 'SizeLargeBtn',
      fields: {
        rect: { x: 414, y: 0, scale: 0.38 },
        filename: 'FrontEnd\\HD\\Final\\FrontEnd_ButtonMed',
        hoveredFrame: 3,
        textString: '대형 12줄',
        onClickMessage: `SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudTrack${tabKey}L`,
        tooltipString: '글자 출력창을 대형(12줄)으로 넓힙니다.',
        textColor: suffix === 'L' ? '$FontColorGoldYellow' : '$LightButtonTextColor',
        'text/style': '$StyleFEButtonText',
        sound: 'select'
      }
    },
    {
      type: 'ButtonWidget',
      name: 'SizeTintToggleBtn',
      fields: {
        rect: { x: 552, y: 0, scale: 0.38 },
        filename: 'FrontEnd\\HD\\Final\\FrontEnd_ButtonMed',
        hoveredFrame: 3,
        textString: showReadabilityBg ? '완전투명' : '가독배경',
        onClickMessage: showReadabilityBg
          ? `SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudTrack${tabKey}B`
          : `SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudTrack${tabKey}`,
        tooltipString: '가독성 반투명 배경 / 배경 완전투명 전환',
        textColor: showReadabilityBg ? '$LightButtonTextColor' : '$FontColorGoldYellow',
        'text/style': '$StyleFEButtonText',
        sound: 'select'
      }
    },
    {
      type: 'ButtonWidget',
      name: 'CloseTrackerSubBtn',
      fields: {
        rect: { x: 696, y: -2, scale: 0.56 },
        filename: 'PANEL\\closebtn_4x',
        hoveredFrame: 3,
        onClickMessage: 'PanelManager:ClosePanel:D2RHudTrackerPanel',
        tooltipString: '@strClose',
        sound: 'cursor_close_window_hd'
      }
    },
    // 100% 1:1 aligned ScrollBar UI matching heightPx!
    makeAlignedScrollBar(922, 42, heightPx, 'ScrollController', 'ScrollView'),
    {
      type: 'ScrollViewWidget',
      name: 'ScrollView',
      fields: {
        rect: { x: 12, y: 42, width: 902, height: heightPx },
        scrollControllerName: 'ScrollController',
        clipChildrenDraw: true
      },
      children: [
        {
          type: 'TableWidget',
          name: 'OptionsTable',
          fields: {
            columns: [{ width: 890, alignment: { h: 'fit', v: 'center' } }],
            rowHeight: 46
          },
          children: tableRows
        }
      ]
    }
  );

  if (escMessage) {
    children.push({
      type: 'ButtonWidget',
      name: 'D2RHudTrackEscActionBtn',
      fields: {
        rect: { x: -9999, y: -9999, scale: 0.01 },
        filename: 'PANEL/minihealthon',
        onClickMessage: escMessage,
        acceptsEscKeyEverywhere: true,
        focusOnMouseOver: false
      }
    });
  }

  return {
    type: 'VideoOptionsPanel',
    name: panelName,
    fields: {
      priority: 201,
      rect: { x: 24, y: 468, width: 960, height: heightPx + 50 },
      anchor: { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 },
      applySettingsImmediately: false
    },
    children
  };
}

function stepsToTrackerLines(stepsSubset, actNumber = null) {
  const lines = [];
  if (actNumber) {
    const actRules = MAP_CHEATSHEET.filter((m) => m.act === `${actNumber}막`);
    if (actRules.length > 0) {
      lines.push({
        text: `★ [${actNumber}막 핵심 던전 길찾기 방향 공식]`,
        color: '$FontColorGoldYellow',
        size: '$MediumFontSize'
      });
      for (const r of actRules) {
        lines.push({
          text: `  · ${r.zone}: ${r.rule}`,
          color: '$DescriptionTextColor',
          size: '$SmallFontSize'
        });
      }
    }
  }
  for (const s of stepsSubset) {
    lines.push({
      text: `■ [${s.condition.value}] ${sanitizeD2RText(s.location)}`,
      color: '$FontColorGoldYellow',
      size: '$MediumFontSize'
    });
    lines.push({
      text: `  ▶ 동선: ${sanitizeD2RText(s.route)}`,
      color: '$FontColorLightGold',
      size: '$SmallFontSize'
    });
    for (let i = 0; i < s.tasks.length; i++) {
      const t = s.tasks[i];
      const isReward = t.text.includes('[필수') || t.text.includes('[보상');
      lines.push({
        text: `  [${i + 1}] ${sanitizeD2RText(t.text)}`,
        color: isReward ? '$FontColorLightGold' : '$DescriptionTextColor',
        size: '$SmallFontSize'
      });
    }
    lines.push({
      text: `  ★ 길찾기: ${sanitizeD2RText(s.note)}`,
      color: '$PanelNoteTextColor',
      size: '$SmallFontSize'
    });
    lines.push({
      text: `  ★ 공략팁: ${sanitizeD2RText(s.strategic_tip)}`,
      color: '$PanelNoteTextColor',
      size: '$SmallFontSize'
    });
  }
  return lines;
}

//    - "원본 퀘스트기록에 탭을더 만들어"
//    - "원본 퀘스트 창에서 1막 2막 3만 선택하면 선택한거 출력되게해"

      {

        name: `QLAct${actIdx}OpenDictBtn`,

          rect: { x: 818, y: 0, scale: 0.41 },
          filename: 'FrontEnd\\HD\\Final\\FrontEnd_ButtonMed',

              columns: [{ width: 920, alignment: { h: 'fit', v: 'center' } }],

}

function buildQLActSubPanel(panelName, actIdx, actTitle, lines, hudTargetPanel) {
  const cols = [190, 497, 805];
  const rows = [312, 617];
  const questCount = actIdx === 4 ? 3 : 6;
  const questWidgets = [];

  for (let q = 0; q < questCount; q++) {
    const cx = cols[q % 3];
    const cy = rows[Math.floor(q / 3)];
    questWidgets.push(
      {
        type: 'ImageWidget',
        name: `QLSocket_${actIdx}_${q}`,
        fields: {
          rect: { x: cx - 30, y: cy - 78 },
          filename: 'QuestIcons\\GoldFrame'
        }
      },
      {
        type: 'ImageWidget',
        name: `QLIcon_${actIdx}_${q}`,
        fields: {
          rect: { x: cx, y: cy },
          filename: `QuestIcons\\a${actIdx}q${q + 1}`
        }
      }
    );
  }

  if (actIdx === 4) {
    questWidgets.push({
      type: 'ImageWidget',
      name: 'QLAct4Cover',
      fields: {
        rect: { x: 82, y: 528 },
        filename: 'PANEL\\Quest_Log\\QLPanelCover'
      }
    });
  }

  const extraActive = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1].map((v, i) => (i === actIdx - 1 ? 0 : 1));
  const romanActive = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1].map((v, i) => (i === actIdx - 1 ? 0 : 1));
  const tableRows = expandTrackerLinesToTableRows(lines, `QLAct${actIdx}`);
  const boxHeight = 420;
  const ox = 88;
  const oy = 842;

  const children = [
    {
      type: 'ImageWidget',

        filename: 'PANEL\\Quest_Log\\QuestLog_BG'

        tabPadding: { x: -2, y: 0 },
        inactiveFrames: extraActive,
        activeFrames: extraActive,
        textStyle: {
          pointSize: '$SmallFontSize',
          alignment: { h: 'center', v: 'center' }

        inactiveTextColor: '$TabsInactiveTextColor',

          'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudTrackStarter'

      }
    },
    {
      type: 'TabBarWidget',
      name: 'Tabs',
      fields: {

        tabCount: 5,

        hoveredFrame: 3,
        textString: '룬·큐빙 사전',

        textColor: '$LightButtonTextColor',
        'text/style': '$StyleFEButtonText',
        sound: 'select'
      }
    },
    makeAlignedScrollBar(ox + 954, oy + 48, boxHeight, 'ScrollController', 'ScrollView'),

      }
    }
  ];

  return {
    type: 'VideoOptionsPanel',
    name: panelName,
    fields: {
      priority: 201,
      anchor: '$LeftPanelAnchor',
      rect: '$LeftPanelRect',
      applySettingsImmediately: false
    },
    children
  };
}

function buildPatchedQuestLogLayouts(actLinesMap) {
  const qlOrig = readD2RJson(path.join(EXTRACTED_VANILLA, 'questlogpaneloriginalhd.json'));
  const qlExp = readD2RJson(path.join(EXTRACTED_VANILLA, 'questlogpanelexpansionhd.json'));

  function patchQuestLog(ql, isExpansion) {
    ql.fields = ql.fields || {};
    ql.fields.defaultWidget = 'QLAct1ToggleHudBtn';
    // Move Title, ShortDescription, LongDescription, Speech off-screen so
    // our Extra Tabs (y: 72) and Act 1~5 Output Box (y: 842..1328) are 100% clean
    for (const c of ql.children) {
      if (['Title', 'ShortDescription', 'LongDescription', 'Speech'].includes(c.name)) {
        c.fields = c.fields || {};
        c.fields.rect = { x: -9999, y: -9999, width: 1, height: 1 };
      }
      if (c.name === 'Tabs') {
        c.fields = c.fields || {};
        c.fields.onSwitchTabMessage = 'QuestLogPanelMessage:SelectTab';
        c.fields.tabMessages = isExpansion
          ? [
              'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudQLAct1',
              'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudQLAct2',
              'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudQLAct3',
              'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudQLAct4',
              'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudQLAct5'
            ]
          : [
              'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudQLAct1',
              'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudQLAct2',
              'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudQLAct3',
              'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudQLAct4'
            ];
      }
    }

    // Add Extra Tabs in the Original Quest Log header (y: 70, right above I, II, III, IV, V)
    ql.children = ql.children.filter((c) => c.name !== 'D2RHudQuestLogExtraTabs');
    ql.children.push({
      type: 'TabBarWidget',
      name: 'D2RHudQuestLogExtraTabs',
      fields: {
        rect: { x: 75, y: 72, scale: 0.71 },
        tabCount: 7,
        filename: 'PANEL\\Quest_Log\\QuestLogTab',
        tabSize: { x: 205, y: 70 },
        tabPadding: { x: -2, y: 0 },
        inactiveFrames: [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
        activeFrames: [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
        textStyle: {
          pointSize: '$SmallFontSize',
          alignment: { h: 'center', v: 'center' }
        },
        activeTextColor: '$TabsActiveTextColorInGame',
        inactiveTextColor: '$TabsInactiveTextColor',
        textStrings: ['1막HUD', '2막HUD', '3막HUD', '4막HUD', '5막HUD', '길찾기맵', '스타터'],
        tabMessages: [
          'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudQLAct1',
          'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudQLAct2',
          'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudQLAct3',
          'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudQLAct4',
          'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudQLAct5',
          'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudTrackMap',
          'SettingsPanelMessage:CheckChanges:D2RHudTrackStarter'
        ]
      }
    });

    // Inject Act-specific Quest & Route Output into Tab0 (Act 1), Tab1 (Act 2), Tab2 (Act 3), Tab3 (Act 4), Tab4 (Act 5)
    const tabMeta = [
      { tabName: 'Tab0', actIdx: 1, title: '1막 자매단 야영지', lines: actLinesMap.Act1, target: 'D2RHudTrackAct1' },
      { tabName: 'Tab1', actIdx: 2, title: '2막 루트 골레인', lines: actLinesMap.Act2, target: 'D2RHudTrackAct2' },
      { tabName: 'Tab2', actIdx: 3, title: '3막 쿠라스트 부두', lines: actLinesMap.Act3, target: 'D2RHudTrackAct3' },
      { tabName: 'Tab3', actIdx: 4, title: '4막 혼돈의 성역', lines: actLinesMap.Act4, target: 'D2RHudTrackAct4' },
      { tabName: 'Tab4', actIdx: 5, title: '5막 해로개스', lines: actLinesMap.Act5, target: 'D2RHudTrackAct5' }
    ];

    for (const tm of tabMeta) {
      const tabWidget = ql.children.find((c) => c.name === tm.tabName);
      if (tabWidget && Array.isArray(tabWidget.children)) {
        tabWidget.children = tabWidget.children.filter((c) => !c.name || !c.name.startsWith('D2RHudQuestLogAct'));
        tabWidget.children.push(buildQuestLogActGuideWidget(tm.actIdx, tm.title, tm.lines, tm.target));
      }
    }

    ql.children = ql.children.filter((c) => c.name !== 'D2RHudOpenTrackerEscBtn');
  }

  patchQuestLog(qlOrig, false);
  patchQuestLog(qlExp, true);

  return {
    'questlogpaneloriginalhd.json': qlOrig,
    'questlogpanelexpansionhd.json': qlExp,
    'D2RHudQLAct1hd.json': buildQLActSubPanel('D2RHudQLAct1', 1, '1막 자매단 야영지', actLinesMap.Act1, 'D2RHudTrackAct1'),
    'D2RHudQLAct2hd.json': buildQLActSubPanel('D2RHudQLAct2', 2, '2막 루트 골레인', actLinesMap.Act2, 'D2RHudTrackAct2'),
    'D2RHudQLAct3hd.json': buildQLActSubPanel('D2RHudQLAct3', 3, '3막 쿠라스트 부두', actLinesMap.Act3, 'D2RHudTrackAct3'),
    'D2RHudQLAct4hd.json': buildQLActSubPanel('D2RHudQLAct4', 4, '4막 혼돈의 성역', actLinesMap.Act4, 'D2RHudTrackAct4'),
    'D2RHudQLAct5hd.json': buildQLActSubPanel('D2RHudQLAct5', 5, '5막 해로개스', actLinesMap.Act5, 'D2RHudTrackAct5')
  };
}

// ============================================================================
// 4. AUTOMAP (TAB KEY) INTEGRATION (automaphd.json)
//    - "탭 누르면 맵이랑 같이 나오게가고"
//    - "왼쪽으로 옮기고 가독성 개선해"
//    - Anchored at TOP-LEFT (x: 24, y: 18) with dark readability background,
//      gold header accent, large crisp fonts ($MediumLargeFontSize / $XMediumFontSize),
//      and 46px rowHeight so lines never overlap or collide with top-right UI!
// ============================================================================
function buildPatchedAutoMapLayout(mapLines) {
  const autoMap = readD2RJson(path.join(EXTRACTED_VANILLA, 'automaphd.json'));
  autoMap.fields = autoMap.fields || {};
  autoMap.fields.maxOpacity = 0.96;
  autoMap.fields.highOpacity = 0.94;
  autoMap.fields.lowOpacity = 0.90;
  autoMap.fields.minOpacity = 0.82;

  const tableRows = expandTrackerLinesToTableRows(mapLines, 'AutoMapHud');
  const mapHudHeight = 368; // 8 crisp rows at rowHeight 46

  autoMap.children = [
    {
      type: 'Widget',
      name: 'D2RHudAutoMapContainer',
      fields: {
        anchor: { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 },
        rect: { x: -2536, y: -60, width: 960, height: mapHudHeight + 52 }
      },
      children: [
        {
          type: 'RectangleWidget',
          name: 'AutoMapHudReadabilityBg',
          fields: {
            rect: { x: 0, y: 40, width: 952, height: mapHudHeight + 10 },
            color: [0.02, 0.02, 0.04, 0.84]
          }
        },
        {
          type: 'RectangleWidget',
          name: 'AutoMapHudTopAccent',
          fields: {
            rect: { x: 0, y: 40, width: 952, height: 3 },
            color: [0.78, 0.66, 0.38, 0.92]
          }
        },
        {
          type: 'ButtonWidget',
          name: 'AutoMapToggleQuestHudBtn',
          fields: {
            rect: { x: 0, y: 0, scale: 0.42 },
            filename: 'FrontEnd\\HD\\Final\\FrontEnd_ButtonMed',
            hoveredFrame: 3,
            textString: '퀘스트HUD 크기조절창',
            onClickMessage: 'PanelManager:TogglePanel:D2RHudTrackerPanel',
            tooltipString: '좌측 중단 투명 퀘스트 출력창(소형/중형/대형 조절)을 켜거나 끕니다.',
            textColor: '$LightButtonTextColor',
            'text/style': '$StyleFEButtonText',
            sound: 'select'
          }
        },
        {
          type: 'ButtonWidget',
          name: 'AutoMapToggleDictBtn',
          fields: {
            rect: { x: 175, y: 0, scale: 0.42 },
            filename: 'FrontEnd\\HD\\Final\\FrontEnd_ButtonMed',
            hoveredFrame: 3,
            textString: '룬워드·큐빙 사전',
            onClickMessage: 'PanelManager:TogglePanel:D2RHudMainPanel',
            tooltipString: '투명 호라드림 대사전(룬워드 98종·큐빙 60종)을 켜거나 끕니다.',
            textColor: '$LightButtonTextColor',
            'text/style': '$StyleFEButtonText',
            sound: 'select'
          }
        },
        makeAlignedScrollBar(922, 44, mapHudHeight, 'AutoMapScrollCtrl', 'AutoMapScrollView'),
        {
          type: 'ScrollViewWidget',
          name: 'AutoMapScrollView',
          fields: {
            rect: { x: 12, y: 44, width: 902, height: mapHudHeight },
            scrollControllerName: 'AutoMapScrollCtrl',
            clipChildrenDraw: true
          },
          children: [
            {
              type: 'TableWidget',
              name: 'AutoMapHudTable',
              fields: {
                columns: [{ width: 890, alignment: { h: 'fit', v: 'center' } }],
                rowHeight: 46
              },
              children: tableRows
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  ];

  return autoMap;
}

// ============================================================================
// 5. PATCH EXISTING LAYOUT ENTRY POINTS
//    - "하단 성역HUD 룬 큐빈사전 삭제하고 체려바 삭제하고"
//      -> Remove D2RHudTrackerToggleBtn, D2RHudDictToggleBtn, miniHealthBar,
//         minihpBar, minimanaBar from hudpanelhd.json, and disable healthProBar!
// ============================================================================
function buildPatchedEntryLayouts(actLinesMap, mapTrackerLines) {
  // 5.1 hudpanelhd.json — Delete bottom 성역HUD, 룬·큐빙사전, and 체력바 buttons!
  const hudPanel = readD2RJson(path.join(YUPGOOLG_MERGED, 'data\\global\\ui\\layouts\\hudpanelhd.json'));
  const removedHudWidgets = new Set([
    'D2RHudTrackerToggleBtn',
    'D2RHudDictToggleBtn',
    'miniHealthBar',
    'minihpBar',
    'minimanaBar',
    'D2RHudHuDOpenTrackerEscBtn'
  ]);
  hudPanel.children = hudPanel.children.filter((c) => !removedHudWidgets.has(c.name));

  // Also neutralize healthProBarhd.json, hpProBarhd.json, manaProBarhd.json
  const emptyHealthBarPanel = (name) => ({
    type: 'PlayerInventoryPanel',
    name,
    fields: {
      anchor: { x: 0.5, y: 1 },
      rect: { x: -9999, y: -9999, width: 1, height: 1 },
      priority: 1
    },
    children: []
  });

  // 5.2 mainmenubuttonribbonhd.json — Character Select left ribbon button
  const mainRibbon = readD2RJson(path.join(YUPGOOLG_MERGED, 'data\\global\\ui\\layouts\\mainmenubuttonribbonhd.json'));
  const ribbonImg = mainRibbon.children.find((c) => c.name === 'Ribbon');
  if (ribbonImg && Array.isArray(ribbonImg.children)) {
    ribbonImg.children = ribbonImg.children.filter((c) => c.name !== 'D2RHudMainMenuBtn' && c.name !== 'D2RHudQuickPlayKeyBtn');
  }

  // 5.2b mainmenupanelhd.json, characterselectpanelhd.json, characterdifficultymodalhd.json
  const mainMenuPanel = readD2RJson(path.join(YUPGOOLG_MERGED, 'data\\global\\ui\\layouts\\mainmenupanelhd.json'));
  const quickPlayBtn = mainMenuPanel.children.find((c) => c.name === 'QuickPlayButton');
  if (quickPlayBtn && quickPlayBtn.fields) {
    quickPlayBtn.fields.acceptsReturnKey = true;
    quickPlayBtn.fields.focusOnMouseOver = false;
  }

  const enableCaptureHooks = process.env.D2R_CAPTURE_HOOKS === '1';

  const charSelectPanel = readD2RJson(path.join(EXTRACTED_VANILLA, 'characterselectpanelhd.json'));
  if (enableCaptureHooks) {
    charSelectPanel.children.push({
      type: 'InputTextBoxWidget',
      name: 'D2RHudCharSelectInput',
      fields: {
        rect: { x: -9999, y: -9999, width: 100, height: 40 },
        maxStringLength: 1,
        alwaysAcceptsKeyInput: true,
        onReturnInputMessage: 'MainMenuHD:Play'
      }
    });
  }

  const diffModal = readD2RJson(path.join(YUPGOOLG_MERGED, 'data\\global\\ui\\layouts\\characterdifficultymodalhd.json'));
  const diffFrame = diffModal.children.find((c) => c.name === 'Frame');
  if (diffFrame && Array.isArray(diffFrame.children)) {
    const normalBtn = diffFrame.children.find((c) => c.name === 'Normal');
    if (normalBtn && normalBtn.fields) {
      normalBtn.fields.acceptsReturnKey = true;
      normalBtn.fields.focusOnMouseOver = false;
    }
  }

  // 5.3 pauselayouthd.json — ESC Pause Menu entry for Quest HUD & Dictionary
  const pauseLayout = readD2RJson(path.join(YUPGOOLG_MERGED, 'data\\global\\ui\\layouts\\pauselayouthd.json'));
  pauseLayout.fields = pauseLayout.fields || {};
  pauseLayout.fields.defaultWidget = 'ReturnToGame';
  const pauseTable = pauseLayout.children.find((c) => c.name === 'PauseTable');
  if (pauseTable && Array.isArray(pauseTable.children)) {
    pauseTable.children = pauseTable.children.filter(
      (c) => c.name !== 'Row D2RHudMenu' && c.name !== 'Row D2RHudTrackerMenu' && c.name !== 'Row D2RHudQuestLogMenu'
    );
    pauseTable.children.splice(
      1,
      0,
      {
        type: 'TableRowWidget',
        name: 'Row D2RHudTrackerMenu',
        children: [
          {
            type: 'ButtonWidget',
            name: 'D2RHudPauseTrackerBtn',
            fields: {
              filename: 'PauseMenu\\PauseButton',
              hoveredFrame: 3,
              textString: '퀘스트 투명HUD',
              onClickMessage: 'PanelManager:TogglePanel:D2RHudTrackerPanel',
              textColor: '$LightButtonTextColor',
              'text/style': '$StyleFEButtonText',
              acceptsReturnKey: true,
              focusOnMouseOver: true,
              sound: 'select'
            }
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        type: 'TableRowWidget',
        name: 'Row D2RHudMenu',
        children: [
          {
            type: 'ButtonWidget',
            name: 'D2RHudPauseBtn',
            fields: {
              filename: 'PauseMenu\\PauseButton',
              hoveredFrame: 3,
              textString: '룬워드·큐빙 사전',
              onClickMessage: 'PanelManager:TogglePanel:D2RHudMainPanel',
              textColor: '$LightButtonTextColor',
              'text/style': '$StyleFEButtonText',
              acceptsReturnKey: true,
              focusOnMouseOver: true,
              sound: 'select'
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    );
  }

  // 5.4 playerinventoryexpansionlayouthd.json — Inventory (I) button
  const invLayout = readD2RJson(
    path.join(YUPGOOLG_MERGED, 'data\\global\\ui\\layouts\\playerinventoryexpansionlayouthd.json')
  );
  invLayout.children = invLayout.children.filter((c) => c.name !== 'D2RHudInvBtn');

  // 5.5 horadriccubelayouthd.json — Horadric Cube button
  const cubeLayout = readD2RJson(path.join(YUPGOOLG_MERGED, 'data\\global\\ui\\layouts\\horadriccubelayouthd.json'));
  cubeLayout.children = cubeLayout.children.filter((c) => c.name !== 'D2RHudCubeDictBtn');
  cubeLayout.children.push({
    type: 'ButtonWidget',
    name: 'D2RHudCubeDictBtn',
    fields: {
      rect: { x: -330, y: 808, scale: 0.62 },
      filename: 'PANEL/infobutton',
      hoveredFrame: 3,
      textString: '큐빙·룬 사전',
      onClickMessage: 'PanelManager:TogglePanel:D2RHudMainPanel',
      tooltipString: '호라드림 큐빙 60종 조합법 및 룬워드 98종 투명 대사전 켜기/끄기',
      textColor: '$LightButtonTextColor',
      'text/style': '$StyleFEButtonText',
      sound: 'select'
    }
  });

  // 5.6 Quest Log (Q) & AutoMap (Tab) patched layouts
  const questLogLayouts = buildPatchedQuestLogLayouts(actLinesMap);
  const autoMapLayout = buildPatchedAutoMapLayout(mapTrackerLines);

  const result = {
    'hudpanelhd.json': hudPanel,
    'healthProBarhd.json': emptyHealthBarPanel('healthProBar'),
    'hpProBarhd.json': emptyHealthBarPanel('hpProBar'),
    'manaProBarhd.json': emptyHealthBarPanel('manaProBar'),
    'mainmenubuttonribbonhd.json': mainRibbon,
    'mainmenupanelhd.json': mainMenuPanel,
    'characterselectpanelhd.json': charSelectPanel,
    'characterdifficultymodalhd.json': diffModal,
    'pauselayouthd.json': pauseLayout,
    'playerinventoryexpansionlayouthd.json': invLayout,
    'horadriccubelayouthd.json': cubeLayout,
    'automaphd.json': autoMapLayout,
    ...questLogLayouts
  };

  if (enableCaptureHooks) {
    const act2Sub = buildQLActSubPanel('D2RHudQLAct2', 2, '2막 루트 골레인', actLinesMap.Act2, 'D2RHudTrackAct2');
    result['helppanelhd.json'] = {
      type: 'HelpPanel',
      name: 'HelpPanel',
      fields: {
        priority: 150,
        fitToParent: true,
        childFormats: []
      },
      children: [
        {
          type: 'Widget',
          name: 'CenterSection',
          fields: {
            anchor: '$LeftPanelAnchor',
            rect: '$LeftPanelRect'
          },
          children: act2Sub.children
        }
      ]
    };

    const act3Sub = buildQLActSubPanel('D2RHudQLAct3', 3, '3막 쿠라스트 부두', actLinesMap.Act3, 'D2RHudTrackAct3');
    result['playerinventoryexpansionlayouthd.json'] = {
      type: 'PlayerInventoryPanel',
      name: 'PlayerInventoryExpansionLayout',
      fields: {
        priority: 150,
        anchor: '$LeftPanelAnchor',
        rect: '$LeftPanelRect'
      },
      children: act3Sub.children
    };

    const charStats = readD2RJson(
      path.join(YUPGOOLG_MERGED, 'data\\global\\ui\\layouts\\characterstatspanelhd.json')
    );
    charStats.fields = charStats.fields || {};
    charStats.fields.priority = 100;
    charStats.fields.rect = { x: -9999, y: -9999, width: 1, height: 1 };
    charStats.children.push({
      type: 'ButtonWidget',
      name: 'D2RHudStatsEscBtn',
      fields: {
        rect: { x: -9999, y: -9999, scale: 0.01 },
        filename: 'PANEL/minihealthon',
        onClickMessage: 'PanelManager:OpenPanel:D2RHudTrackerPanel',
        acceptsEscKeyEverywhere: true,
        focusOnMouseOver: false
      }
    });
    result['characterstatspanelhd.json'] = charStats;
  }

  return result;
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN GENERATION PIPELINE
// ============================================================================
function main() {
  const generatedLayouts = {};

  // 1. Transparent & Adjustable Main Encyclopedia + Fold + 7 Tabs x 3 Sizes (S/Default/L)
  generatedLayouts['D2RHudMainPanelhd.json'] = buildMainPanel();
  generatedLayouts['D2RHudMainFoldhd.json'] = buildMainFoldSubPanel();

  const act1to3Steps = questTimeline.steps.filter((s) =>
    ['Act 1-1', 'Act 1-2', 'Act 2-1', 'Act 2-2', 'Act 3-1', 'Act 3-2'].includes(s.condition.value)
  );
  const act4to5Steps = questTimeline.steps.filter((s) =>
    ['Act 4', 'Act 5-1', 'Act 5-2'].includes(s.condition.value)
  );

  const rw23 = runewords.filter((r) => r.category && (r.category.includes('2홈') || r.category.includes('3홈')));
  const rw4 = runewords.filter((r) => r.category && r.category.includes('4홈'));
  const rw56 = runewords.filter((r) => !rw23.includes(r) && !rw4.includes(r));

  const mainTabs = [
    { key: 'Camp1', rows: generateCampaignRows(act1to3Steps, false) },
    { key: 'Camp2', rows: generateCampaignRows(act4to5Steps, true) },
    { key: 'Starter', rows: generateStarterRows() },
    { key: 'Rw23', rows: generateRunewordRows(rw23, '2홈 ~ 3홈 핵심 룬워드 사전') },
    { key: 'Rw4', rows: generateRunewordRows(rw4, '4홈 핵심 룬워드 사전 (영혼·통찰·무공·오심·인내·불사조 등)') },
    { key: 'Rw56', rows: generateRunewordRows(rw56, '5홈 ~ 6홈 & 신규(악마술사/2.4~2.6) 룬워드 사전') },
    { key: 'Cube', rows: generateCubeRows() }
  ];

  for (const t of mainTabs) {
    generatedLayouts[`D2RHud${t.key}SPanelhd.json`] = buildEncyclopediaSubPanel(t.key, 'S', t.rows, 360, 56);
    generatedLayouts[`D2RHud${t.key}Panelhd.json`] = buildEncyclopediaSubPanel(t.key, '', t.rows, 640, 56);
    generatedLayouts[`D2RHud${t.key}LPanelhd.json`] = buildEncyclopediaSubPanel(t.key, 'L', t.rows, 1020, 56);
  }

  // 2. 100% Transparent & Adjustable In-Game Quest HUD Bar + Fold + 7 Tabs x 4 Modes (S/Default/L/B)
  generatedLayouts['D2RHudTrackerPanelhd.json'] = buildTrackerMainPanel();
  generatedLayouts['D2RHudTrackFoldhd.json'] = buildTrackerFoldSubPanel();

  const mapTrackerLines = [
    {
      text: '■ 성역 주요 던전 길찾기 방향 공식 12선 (입구 타일 시선 기준)',
      color: '$FontColorGoldYellow',
      size: '$MediumFontSize'
    },
    ...MAP_CHEATSHEET.flatMap((m) => [
      {
        text: `· [${m.act}] ${m.zone} → ${m.rule}`,
        color: '$DescriptionTextColor',
        size: '$SmallFontSize'
      },
      {
        text: `   → ${m.detail}`,
        color: '$PanelNoteTextColor',
        size: '$SmallFontSize'
      }
    ])
  ];

  const actLinesMap = {
    Act1: stepsToTrackerLines(questTimeline.steps.filter((s) => s.condition.value.startsWith('Act 1')), 1),
    Act2: stepsToTrackerLines(questTimeline.steps.filter((s) => s.condition.value.startsWith('Act 2')), 2),
    Act3: stepsToTrackerLines(questTimeline.steps.filter((s) => s.condition.value.startsWith('Act 3')), 3),
    Act4: stepsToTrackerLines(questTimeline.steps.filter((s) => s.condition.value.startsWith('Act 4')), 4),
    Act5: stepsToTrackerLines(questTimeline.steps.filter((s) => s.condition.value.startsWith('Act 5')), 5),
    Map: mapTrackerLines,
    Starter: stepsToTrackerLines(warlockGuide.steps)
  };

  const trackerTabs = [
    { key: 'Act1', lines: actLinesMap.Act1 },
    { key: 'Act2', lines: actLinesMap.Act2 },
    { key: 'Act3', lines: actLinesMap.Act3 },
    { key: 'Act4', lines: actLinesMap.Act4 },
    { key: 'Act5', lines: actLinesMap.Act5 },
    { key: 'Map', lines: actLinesMap.Map },
    { key: 'Starter', lines: actLinesMap.Starter }
  ];

  const enableCaptureHooks = process.env.D2R_CAPTURE_HOOKS === '1';
  for (const t of trackerTabs) {
    for (const suffix of ['', 'S', 'L', 'B']) {
      const escMsg = enableCaptureHooks && t.key === 'Act1' && suffix === '' ? 'PanelManager:OpenPanel:AutoMap' : null;
      generatedLayouts[`D2RHudTrack${t.key}${suffix}hd.json`] = buildTrackerSubPanel(t.key, suffix, t.lines, escMsg);
    }
  }

  // 3. Patched Entry Layouts (HUDPanel, QuestLog, AutoMap, PauseMenu, Cube)
  const patchedEntries = buildPatchedEntryLayouts(actLinesMap, mapTrackerLines);
  Object.assign(generatedLayouts, patchedEntries);

  const outStandaloneLayouts = path.join(OUT_MOD_DIR, 'data', 'global', 'ui', 'layouts');
  const outYupgoolgLayouts = path.join(OUT_YUPGOOLG_OVERLAY, 'data', 'global', 'ui', 'layouts');
  const outSeonheeLayouts = path.join(SEONHEE_MOD, 'data', 'global', 'ui', 'layouts');

  ensureDir(outStandaloneLayouts);
  ensureDir(outYupgoolgLayouts);

  for (const existing of fs.readdirSync(outStandaloneLayouts)) {
    if (existing.endsWith('.json') && existing !== '_profilehd.json' && !(existing in generatedLayouts)) {
      fs.unlinkSync(path.join(outStandaloneLayouts, existing));
    }
  }
  for (const existing of fs.readdirSync(outYupgoolgLayouts)) {
    if (existing.endsWith('.json') && !(existing in generatedLayouts)) {
      fs.unlinkSync(path.join(outYupgoolgLayouts, existing));
    }
  }

  const profileHd = readD2RJson(path.join(YUPGOOLG_MERGED, 'data\\global\\ui\\layouts\\_profilehd.json'));
  writeJson(path.join(outStandaloneLayouts, '_profilehd.json'), profileHd);
  writeJson(path.join(OUT_MOD_DIR, '..', 'd2rhud.json'), {
    name: 'd2rhud',
    savepath: 'd2rhud/'
  });

  const writtenFiles = [];
  for (const [fileName, jsonObj] of Object.entries(generatedLayouts)) {
    const p1 = path.join(outStandaloneLayouts, fileName);
    const p2 = path.join(outYupgoolgLayouts, fileName);
    writeJson(p1, jsonObj);
    writeJson(p2, jsonObj);
    if (fs.existsSync(outSeonheeLayouts)) {
      writeJson(path.join(outSeonheeLayouts, fileName), jsonObj);
    }
    writtenFiles.push({
      fileName,
      mpqPath: `data\\global\\ui\\layouts\\${fileName}`,
      bytes: fs.statSync(p1).size
    });
  }

  console.log(`Generated ${writtenFiles.length} native D2R Resurrected UI layout JSON files:`);
  for (const f of writtenFiles) {
    console.log(`  - ${f.mpqPath} (${f.bytes.toLocaleString()} bytes)`);
  }
}

main();

================================================================================

ROLE: StormLib.dll을 이용해 yupgoolg.mpq 내부에 UI 레이아웃 JSON을 직접 패킹·검증하는 설치 스크립트

import ctypes
from ctypes import wintypes
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil

STORMLIB_DLL = r"C:\Users\icand\Downloads\D2R-Yupgoolg-20261025\stormlib\x64\StormLib.dll"
INSTALLED_MPQ = r"D:\Diablo II Resurrected\mods\yupgoolg\yupgoolg.mpq"
BACKUP_MPQ = r"D:\Diablo II Resurrected\mods\yupgoolg\yupgoolg.before-d2rhud.mpq"
PATCH_DIR = r"C:\Users\icand\.gemini\antigravity\scratch\D2R-HUD\mod\yupgoolg-patch\data\global\ui\layouts"
STANDALONE_MPQ = r"C:\Users\icand\.gemini\antigravity\scratch\D2R-HUD\mod\d2rhud\d2rhud.mpq"
RECEIPT_PATH = r"C:\Users\icand\.gemini\antigravity\scratch\D2R-HUD\mpq-install-receipt.json"

MPQ_FILE_COMPRESS = 0x00000200
MPQ_FILE_REPLACEEXISTING = 0x80000000
MPQ_COMPRESSION_ZLIB = 0x02

storm = ctypes.WinDLL(STORMLIB_DLL)

storm.SFileOpenArchive.argtypes = [wintypes.LPCWSTR, wintypes.DWORD, wintypes.DWORD, ctypes.POINTER(wintypes.HANDLE)]
storm.SFileOpenArchive.restype = wintypes.BOOL

storm.SFileCloseArchive.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE]
storm.SFileCloseArchive.restype = wintypes.BOOL

storm.SFileFlushArchive.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE]
storm.SFileFlushArchive.restype = wintypes.BOOL

storm.SFileAddFileEx.argtypes = [
    wintypes.HANDLE,
    wintypes.LPCWSTR,
    wintypes.LPCSTR,
    wintypes.DWORD,
    wintypes.DWORD,
    wintypes.DWORD,
]
storm.SFileAddFileEx.restype = wintypes.BOOL

storm.SFileHasFile.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE, wintypes.LPCSTR]
storm.SFileHasFile.restype = wintypes.BOOL

storm.SFileOpenFileEx.argtypes = [
    wintypes.HANDLE,
    wintypes.LPCSTR,
    wintypes.DWORD,
    ctypes.POINTER(wintypes.HANDLE),
]
storm.SFileOpenFileEx.restype = wintypes.BOOL

storm.SFileGetFileSize.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE, ctypes.POINTER(wintypes.DWORD)]
storm.SFileGetFileSize.restype = wintypes.DWORD

storm.SFileReadFile.argtypes = [
    wintypes.HANDLE,
    wintypes.LPVOID,
    wintypes.DWORD,
    ctypes.POINTER(wintypes.DWORD),
    wintypes.LPVOID,
]
storm.SFileReadFile.restype = wintypes.BOOL

storm.SFileCloseFile.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE]
storm.SFileCloseFile.restype = wintypes.BOOL


def sha256_file(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        while chunk := f.read(1024 * 1024):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def read_mpq_file(hMpq, archived_name):
    hFile = wintypes.HANDLE()
    if not storm.SFileOpenFileEx(hMpq, archived_name.encode("utf-8"), 0, ctypes.byref(hFile)):
        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to open {archived_name} in MPQ")
    try:
        high = wintypes.DWORD(0)
        size = storm.SFileGetFileSize(hFile, ctypes.byref(high))
        buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(size)
        read_bytes = wintypes.DWORD(0)
        if not storm.SFileReadFile(hFile, buf, size, ctypes.byref(read_bytes), None):
            raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to read {archived_name} in MPQ")
        return buf.raw[: read_bytes.value]
    finally:
        storm.SFileCloseFile(hFile)


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(BACKUP_MPQ):
        shutil.copy2(INSTALLED_MPQ, BACKUP_MPQ)
        print(f"Created backup MPQ: {BACKUP_MPQ}")

    before_sha = sha256_file(INSTALLED_MPQ)

    hMpq = wintypes.HANDLE()
    if not storm.SFileOpenArchive(INSTALLED_MPQ, 0, 0, ctypes.byref(hMpq)):
        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to open MPQ archive: {INSTALLED_MPQ}")

    injected = []
    try:
        for fname in sorted(os.listdir(PATCH_DIR)):
            if not fname.endswith(".json"):
                continue
            disk_path = os.path.join(PATCH_DIR, fname)
            mpq_path = f"data\\global\\ui\\layouts\\{fname}"
            flags = MPQ_FILE_COMPRESS | MPQ_FILE_REPLACEEXISTING
            ok = storm.SFileAddFileEx(
                hMpq,
                disk_path,
                mpq_path.encode("utf-8"),
                flags,
                MPQ_COMPRESSION_ZLIB,
                MPQ_COMPRESSION_ZLIB,
            )
            if not ok:
                err = ctypes.GetLastError()
                raise RuntimeError(f"SFileAddFileEx failed for {mpq_path} (WinError {err})")
            injected.append((disk_path, mpq_path))

        for restore_name in ("helppanelhd.json", "characterstatspanelhd.json"):
            if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(PATCH_DIR, restore_name)):
                orig_file = os.path.join(
                    r"C:\Users\icand\Downloads\D2R-Yupgoolg-20261025\arrow\merged\mods\yupgoolg\yupgoolg.mpq\data\global\ui\layouts",
                    restore_name,
                )
                if os.path.exists(orig_file):
                    storm.SFileAddFileEx(
                        hMpq,
                        orig_file,
                        f"data\\global\\ui\\layouts\\{restore_name}".encode("utf-8"),
                        MPQ_FILE_COMPRESS | MPQ_FILE_REPLACEEXISTING,
                        MPQ_COMPRESSION_ZLIB,
                        MPQ_COMPRESSION_ZLIB,
                    )

        storm.SFileFlushArchive(hMpq)
    finally:
        storm.SFileCloseArchive(hMpq)

    # Re-open in read-only mode (0x100 = MPQ_OPEN_READ_ONLY) and verify every file
    hVerify = wintypes.HANDLE()
    if not storm.SFileOpenArchive(INSTALLED_MPQ, 0, 0x00000100, ctypes.byref(hVerify)):
        raise RuntimeError("Failed to reopen MPQ for verification")

    verified = []
    try:
        for disk_path, mpq_path in injected:
            has = bool(storm.SFileHasFile(hVerify, mpq_path.encode("utf-8")))
            raw_mpq = read_mpq_file(hVerify, mpq_path)
            with open(disk_path, "rb") as f:
                raw_disk = f.read()
            parsed = json.loads(raw_mpq.decode("utf-8"))
            match = raw_mpq == raw_disk
            if not (has and match):
                raise RuntimeError(f"Verification mismatch for {mpq_path}")
            verified.append(
                {
                    "mpqPath": mpq_path,
                    "panelType": parsed.get("type"),
                    "panelName": parsed.get("name"),
                    "bytes": len(raw_mpq),
                    "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw_mpq).hexdigest(),
                    "verifiedInMpq": True,
                }
            )
    finally:
        storm.SFileCloseArchive(hVerify)

    after_sha = sha256_file(INSTALLED_MPQ)
    receipt = {
        "installedMpqPath": INSTALLED_MPQ,
        "backupMpqPath": BACKUP_MPQ,
        "beforeSha256": before_sha,
        "afterSha256": after_sha,
        "totalInjectedFiles": len(verified),
        "allVerifiedByteExact": True,
        "files": verified,
    }
    with open(RECEIPT_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(receipt, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    print(f"Successfully injected and verified {len(verified)} native UI layouts into {INSTALLED_MPQ}")
    print(f"MPQ SHA256: {before_sha} -> {after_sha}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

================================================================================
